scene: The boat glides to a lively transit dock.
picture: A flat side view along a wide wooden transit deck. Far left sits an open-doored silver monorail car. Up high rests a tilted red funicular car. Centre stands an elderly East Asian man in a blue flat cap and orange cardigan with a wooden cane. Far right waits a driver on a brass-trimmed rickshaw.
shown: a sleek silver monorail car waiting with doors open, on the far left
a red wooden funicular tram resting on a sloped track, up high
a brass-trimmed pedal rickshaw with a friendly driver seated, far right
